events.title: Chocolate Parade
events.summary: “The Ultimate Sweets’ Heavy-Weapons Zubabababa Battle!”Chocolate Parade is a chaotic roguelike action game where you roll around as sweets and blast away with heavy weapons! Play solo or in co-op, build your very own parade, and fight for coins on a battlefield where an all-out boss rush awaits!

events.title: Chocolate Parade Demo — Update (2026.8.12)
events.summary: Bug FixesFixed an issue where the Level 5 bonus was not applied to Waffle's machine gun.Fixed an issue where an effect would loop indefinitely if a shot hit the ground at the exact moment a battle ended.You can pick up the update from your Steam library. If you're in the middle of a session, please quit the game once and start it again.For bug reports and feedback, feel free to reach us on the Community Hub or on X (@choco_parade).

events.title: Demo Out Now — Sweets With Heavy Weapons, Up to 3-Player Co-op
events.summary: The demo for Chocolate Parade is out now on Steam, free to play.A chaotic brawl of sweets and heavy weaponry, wrapped up in a roguelike action game.About four minutes per run. Online co-op for up to three players.A chaotic brawl of sweets. Fast, replayable roguelike action in four-minute runsYou control a cast of adorable confections, defeating enemies and collecting coins to chase a high score. The controls are intuitive and each run takes about four minutes, so the pace keeps pulling you back
